content_sections.heading: NTPC Assistant Officer Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts Apply Online | Official Notification PDF

rows.ntpc_limited: Bachelor's degree with relevant postgraduate degree or diploma

content_sections.heading: NTPC Assistant Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities will be provided according to Government of India guidelines. NTPC may increase or decrease the number of vacancies according to organisational requirements.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess both of the following full-time qualifications: A bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 60% marks from a recognised university or institute. A two-year postgraduate degree or postgraduate diploma in Mass Communication, Journalism, Advertising and Communication, Public Relations or a combination of these subjects, with at least 60% marks. All qualifications must be full-time and obtained from universities or institutions recognised and approved in India.

content_sections.heading: Marks Relaxation
content_sections.text: Where a vacancy is identified for the respective category, SC, ST and PwBD candidates with at least 55% marks in the required qualification are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the Assistant Officer post is 29 years . Age will be calculated as on the last date for submitting the online application.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: As per Government of India guidelines

rows.pay_scale: Rs.30,000 to Rs.1,20,000 under the IDA pay scale

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is non-refundable. Candidates can pay online using net banking, debit card or credit card. Offline payment can also be made through the prescribed SBI pay-in-slip.

rows.category: SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and Female candidates

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: NTPC may conduct a multi-stage selection process depending on its requirements. The stages may include: Application shortlisting or screening Written or computer-based test Personal interview If selection is made through an online test and interview, the final result will carry the following weightage: Candidates must qualify separately in the written test and interview. The online test will contain a Subject Knowledge Test and an Executive Aptitude Test . Candidates must qualify separately in both sections.

content_sections.heading: Medical Examination
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination conducted by the NTPC Medical Board or Medical Officer before joining. No relaxation in the prescribed health standards will be allowed.

content_sections.heading: Posting Details
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be posted at any NTPC office, station, project, joint venture or subsidiary. The post is transferable at the discretion of NTPC management.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Class 10 passing certificate or marksheet PAN card Aadhaar card Bachelor's degree certificate Postgraduate degree or postgraduate diploma certificate Consolidated marksheet, transcript or all semester marksheets for graduation and postgraduate qualifications Marks conversion formula, where grades or CGPA are converted into percentages Applicable caste, EWS or disability certificate Current financial year OBC-NCL certificate, where applicable Current Income and Asset Certificate for EWS applicants Disability certificate issued in the prescribed Central Government format through the Swavalamban or UDID portal, where applicable The candidate's name and date of birth should match across the Class 10 certificate, PAN card and Aadhaar card.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTPC Assistant Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: No application or supporting document needs to be sent to NTPC by post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Only online applications will be accepted. The category selected in the online application cannot be changed later. Applications without complete supporting documents may be rejected. Candidates must provide an active and valid email address. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant. Addenda, corrigenda and recruitment updates will be published only on the NTPC website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NTPC Assistant Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NTPC has announced 15 Assistant Officer (Corporate Communication) vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 5 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application begin?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates require a bachelor's degree and a relevant two-year postgraduate degree or postgraduate diploma, with the prescribed marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 29 years, with applicable relaxation for eligible reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the NTPC Assistant Officer salary?
faq.answer: The post carries the E0 grade with an IDA pay scale of Rs.30,000 to Rs.1,20,000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General, EWS and OBC candidates must pay Rs.500. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and female candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process may include application screening, an online written test and a personal interview.
